title: Increasing Tangential Gain
statement: Increasing the tangential gain will reduce the robot's tendency to drift towards obstacles, leading to a more stable and collision-free path.
mechanism: The tangential gain controls the robot's ability to adjust its direction to avoid obstacles while moving forward.
